# Generated contracts (do not edit)

Files in `generated/` are produced by `pnpm contracts:gen`:

- `rest.zod.ts` — REST schemas/client generated by orval from `openapi.json`
- `ws.d.ts` — WebSocket message types generated from `ws.schema.json`

Edit only the Pydantic models under `apps/server/app/contracts/`; CI fails when
regeneration produces a diff (PRD §5.6).
